text: {"features":[{"name":"Role-specific motivation","description":"How clearly the letter explains why this exact Information Security Engineering role at Google is a compelling next step for the applicant.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Expresses only generic interest in software or security work, with little indication of why this specific role or team is targeted."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows interest in security or Google in broad terms, but the reasons could apply to many engineering roles."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects the applicant's interests to one or two parts of the role, such as secure defaults or security tooling, without much personalization."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a clear and credible explanation of why the team's mission and responsibilities match the applicant's goals and prior work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a distinctive and memorable rationale for joining this exact team, tightly linking personal motivation, past experience, and desired impact."}]},{"name":"Security automation insight","description":"How well the letter shows understanding of using engineering to embed security into development workflows and scale security response.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Treats security as a vague interest and shows no real understanding of development-lifecycle security or scalable automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions secure development or automation in broad terms, but does not show how security work is operationalized."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Identifies relevant ideas such as secure defaults, vulnerability handling, or reducing manual work, but stays fairly general."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows solid understanding of the team's work by discussing concrete security-lifecycle problems such as triage, response, or scaling scarce expertise through tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates nuanced grasp of the role's problem space, such as variant analysis, agent guardrails, or turning expert findings into repeatable protection across many teams."}]},{"name":"Platform mindset","description":"How clearly the letter shows motivation and fit for foundational systems whose benefits compound across many teams or products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frames the job mainly as another software role and shows no meaningful platform or large-scale infrastructure mindset."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Notes scale or infrastructure in passing, but does not make foundational impact part of the case."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows general interest in backend or infrastructure work and some appreciation for broader organizational impact."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly emphasizes foundational systems, central tooling, or compounding impact across many downstream teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes a strong case for platform-minded fit by consistently linking past choices and future goals to high-leverage infrastructure that scales organizational capability."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement orientation","description":"How strongly the letter frames security tooling as a way to help developer teams work safely with less friction.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Focuses almost entirely on the applicant's interests or achievements and does not acknowledge the engineers who would use the tooling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Briefly mentions helping teams or reducing burden, but the pitch remains mostly self-focused."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a general desire to make secure behavior easier for other engineers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly emphasizes serving developer teams through usable defaults, lower friction, or tools built close to user needs."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently frames impact in terms of developer adoption and workflow fit, showing mature empathy for internal users and how secure behavior becomes habitual."}]},{"name":"Production software experience","description":"How strongly the letter establishes relevant experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software at meaningful scope.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Fails to establish more than minimal production experience, for example by describing only about three years of work and very limited service ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a modest production record, such as a few years with several launches or longer tenure with narrow service scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows sustained ownership of multiple production services over several years, typically around five years or equivalent."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows extensive relevant tenure, typically five to seven years, with repeated testing, maintenance, and launches across numerous systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows the strongest level of production background, typically around seven years with extensive ownership of many launched and maintained services."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How convincingly the letter demonstrates hands-on Go experience relevant to building back-end systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only superficially or not at all, leaving no evidence of meaningful backend use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States Go as a working language but gives little evidence that it has been central to the applicant's work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes clear that Go has been used regularly in production work, though with limited detail about its role."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows Go as a primary or daily language in production systems tied to backend or infrastructure responsibilities."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Positions Go as a true core strength through sustained production use and direct relevance to backend systems like those in the role."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates practical Python use for services, automation, analysis, or AI tooling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or gives no evidence of hands-on use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python as a familiar language with little detail about what it is used for."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes regular Python use for tooling or services in a believable but moderate way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows extensive Python use across multiple functions such as automation, analysis, services, or test tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a production-grade strength central to automation, analysis, services, or agent work, with clear evidence of depth and reliability."}]},{"name":"Security assessment experience","description":"How convincingly the letter shows experience evaluating systems for security issues through reviews, threat modeling, or similar assessment work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of performing security assessments and offers only general interest in security."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals some exposure to security review, but does not name concrete assessment activities or responsibilities."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience with security assessments in general terms, such as code review or threat modeling, without much detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes hands-on assessment work with concrete activities such as attack-surface mapping, structured reviews, or validation of fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows mature assessment capability by describing thorough evaluations that connect design intent, code behavior, attack surface, and remediation follow-through."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability handling automation","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no example of automating vulnerability handling or security response workflows."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Refers to security automation broadly, but not to vulnerability reporting or triage in a concrete way."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a clear example of building tooling for vulnerability intake or triage, but with limited detail on what changed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a concrete vulnerability-handling automation that classifies, deduplicates, routes, or otherwise meaningfully reduces manual work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents vulnerability workflow automation as a substantial accomplishment with a clear before-and-after story and strong alignment to intake, triage, and response needs."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems architecture","description":"How well the letter demonstrates experience designing systems in which agents act within back-end controls and boundaries.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agents or autonomous multi-step tooling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Uses the language of agents or autonomy, but gives no concrete architectural detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Indicates some hands-on work with agentic tooling or multi-step autonomous workflows."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes end-to-end design of agentic systems, typically with Python agents operating inside explicit backend controls."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows sophisticated agent design thinking, including bounded actions, contracts, supervision, logging, or guardrails that make agent behavior auditable and safe."}]},{"name":"Applied AI production experience","description":"How convincingly the letter shows practical experience shipping AI features with attention to production reliability.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of working with AI in production."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI as an interest or buzzword without evidence of shipped work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience building or shipping AI features in production, but with limited detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes meaningful production use of AI or LLM-backed functionality and signals awareness of reliability or evaluation concerns."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents strong applied AI experience that explicitly balances capability with trustworthiness, evaluation, or failure-mode management in production systems."}]},{"name":"Data structures and algorithms depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates problem-solving depth through concrete algorithmic or data-structure work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention algorithmic work or offers only a generic competence claim with no example."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions algorithms or problem-solving broadly, but without a specific technical case."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one credible example of using data structures or algorithms to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a substantial algorithmic improvement with clear technical relevance, such as redesigning core logic or removing a bottleneck."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents algorithmic strength as a standout asset through a sharp, concrete example that shows both technical depth and impact on an important system path."}]},{"name":"Engineering rigor","description":"How strongly the letter conveys a disciplined approach to correctness, reliability, guardrails, and trustworthy system behavior.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Says little about reliability, quality, or disciplined engineering beyond generic competence claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at care or correctness, but without concrete language about how rigor shows up in the work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Communicates a believable concern for dependable systems, predictable behavior, or high standards."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly describes rigorous practices or design principles such as typed and tested code, auditability, bounded actions, or reliability over novelty."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes engineering rigor a defining theme of the letter, showing a notably high bar for trustworthy behavior in security-critical or AI-assisted systems."}]},{"name":"Offensive security credibility","description":"How strongly the letter establishes an attacker's-eye security perspective through certifications, competitions, or equivalent independent practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no evidence of offensive-security practice or externally validated security skill."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Suggests an attacker's perspective only indirectly, without any notable independent proof of practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some credible independent security development, such as occasional CTF participation or a basic security certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a strong signal such as high CTF performance or a demanding hands-on certification like OSCP."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Combines multiple strong signals of offensive-security capability or demonstrates especially high-level independent practice and validation."}]},{"name":"Open-source stewardship","description":"How strongly the letter shows contribution to or maintenance of open-source software beyond ordinary day-to-day job duties.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention open-source work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional patching or bug fixes, with little sense of ongoing ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular contribution behavior or upstream patching that demonstrates technical initiative."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes meaningful stewardship such as maintaining a project, handling reviews, or managing releases."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents substantial open-source leadership with ongoing responsibility for direction, contributor management, and releases on a project used beyond the applicant's immediate team."}]},{"name":"Personal technical initiative","description":"How strongly the letter uses self-directed technical projects to show curiosity and engineering drive outside assigned work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of self-directed technical work outside formal employment."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small side project with limited technical ambition or relevance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a credible personal build that demonstrates ongoing initiative and follow-through."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a technically meaningful side project that clearly strengthens fit for backend, infrastructure, or security-oriented work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a substantial self-directed undertaking involving genuinely hard engineering problems that strongly reinforces the applicant's capabilities and drive."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How much the letter backs claims with concrete examples, mechanisms, and observable outcomes rather than generic assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims of skill or interest with few concrete examples."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes some specific experiences, but leaves many claims unsupported or vague."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports major claims with at least a few concrete examples, though outcomes or mechanisms may remain thin."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Regularly grounds claims in specific projects, tasks, or improvements that make the applicant's contribution easy to picture."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently pairs claims with sharp, role-relevant examples and clear before-and-after effects, making the letter highly credible and evidence-based."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"How clear, professional, and mechanically polished the letter is at the sentence level and across the overall flow.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent spelling, grammar, or sentence-construction problems that distract the reader and weaken credibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has multiple noticeable errors or awkward fragments, but remains understandable overall."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is generally readable and professional, though it contains a few noticeable errors or uneven transitions."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Reads smoothly with strong organization and only minor mechanical issues, if any."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is exceptionally polished, clear, and easy to follow, with confident phrasing and essentially no distracting errors."}]}]}
